COPY (SELECT * FROM 'datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/metric_container.parquet'
      WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 04:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 08:00:00')
TO 'datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet'

SELECT count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT cmdb_id) AS cmdbs, count(DISTINCT kpi_name) AS kpis
FROM 'datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet';

SELECT cmdb_id, count_star() AS n, count(DISTINCT kpi_name) AS kpis FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, ts, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 05:55:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet"), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, max("value") AS b_max, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE (NOT in_win) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS w_avg, max("value") AS w_max, min("value") AS w_min, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT w.cmdb_id, w.kpi_name, round(b.b_avg, 4) AS b_avg, round(b.b_max, 4) AS b_max, round(w.w_avg, 4) AS w_avg, round(w.w_max, 4) AS w_max, round(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_max, round(((w.w_avg - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_avg FROM win AS w INNER JOIN base AS b USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b.b_n >= 20) AND (w.w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0))) > 4)) ORDER BY abs(z_max) DESC LIMIT 40 LIMIT 10000

WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 05:55:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet"), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE (NOT in_win) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, max("value") AS w_max, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT cmdb_id, count_star() AS n_anom FROM win INNER JOIN base USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b_n >= 20) AND (w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0))) > 4)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('10 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Mysql01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Mysql01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Mysql02')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Mysql02, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'apache01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS apache01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Tomcat01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat02')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Tomcat02 FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE (kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKWrite') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%DSKRead')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS dsk_read_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%DSKRTps')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS dsk_rtps_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%NoCacheMemPerc')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS nocache_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUCpuUtil')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS cpu_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUWio')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS wio_max FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT cmdb_id, ts, round("value", 1) AS v FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 50)) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10000

SELECT kpi_name, round(min("value"), 2) AS mn, round(avg("value"), 2) AS av, round(max("value"), 2) AS mx FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') AND (kpi_name ~~* '%MEM%')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('10 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Mysql01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Mysql01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Mysql02')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Mysql02, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'apache01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS apache01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Tomcat01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat02')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Tomcat02 FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE (kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKWrite') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%DSKRead')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS dsk_read_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%DSKRTps')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS dsk_rtps_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%NoCacheMemPerc')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS nocache_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUCpuUtil')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS cpu_max, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUWio')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS wio_max FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT cmdb_id, ts, round("value", 1) AS v FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 50)) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%NoCacheMemPerc')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS nocache_pct, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%MEMUsedMemPerc')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS used_pct, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%MEMFreeMem')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 0) AS free_mb, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%CacheMem')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 0) AS cache_mb, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%UserMem')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 0) AS user_mb, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%JVMMemoryUsedPercent')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS jvm_pct FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 06:10:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max("value"), 0) AS user_mb_max, round(min("value"), 0) AS user_mb_min FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') AND (kpi_name ~~ '%MEMORY_UserMem') AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 05:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 07:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT cmdb_id, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:35:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS win_max, round(avg(CASE  WHEN ((ts < CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS pre_avg FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE (kpi_name ~~ '%NoCacheMemPerc') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (win_max - pre_avg) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, cmdb_id, round("value", 1) AS dskwrite FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet" WHERE ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKWrite') AND ("value" > 100)) ORDER BY ts, cmdb_id LIMIT 10000

WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:35:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win, (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 05:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS burst FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_003/metric_window.parquet"), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE ((NOT in_win) AND (NOT burst)) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, max("value") AS w_max, avg("value") AS w_avg, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, round(b_avg, 3) AS b_avg, round(w_max, 3) AS w_max, round(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0)), 1) AS z_max FROM win INNER JOIN base USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b_n >= 20) AND (w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0))) > 8)) ORDER BY abs(z_max) DESC LIMIT 25 LIMIT 10000

SELECT cmdb_id, log_name, count_star() AS n FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/log_service.parquet" WHERE (("day" = CAST('2021-03-06' AS "DATE")) AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AND (log_name NOT IN ('localhost_access_log', 'apache_access_log'))) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30 LIMIT 10000

SELECT cmdb_id, log_name, count_star() AS n FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/log_service.parquet" WHERE (("day" = CAST('2021-03-06' AS "DATE")) AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 05:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 05:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AND (log_name NOT IN ('localhost_access_log', 'apache_access_log'))) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, tc, round(avg(sr), 4) AS sr, round(avg(mrt), 1) AS mrt, round(avg(rr), 4) AS rr FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/metric_app.parquet" WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 06:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING ((avg(sr) < 1) OR (avg(rr) > 0)) ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 40 LIMIT 10000
